title: A Visit to the Dentist（看牙醫記）
passage:
Last week, Amy had a terrible toothache. It was so painful that she could not eat her favorite ice cream. Her mother said, "You have to see a dentist right away." Amy felt nervous because she used to be afraid of the dentist's office when she was younger.

When they arrived, the dentist smiled and said, "Don't worry, the checkup is painless." First, the dentist took an X-ray to look inside Amy's tooth. She found a small cavity and had to fill it carefully. Amy closed her eyes, but the treatment was over before she knew it.

"You must brush your teeth twice a day and floss every night," the dentist explained. "You should also eat less sugar and drink more water." Amy nodded and promised to build healthier habits.

On the way home, Amy felt so relieved that she wanted to celebrate. "I used to hate going to the dentist," she told her mother, "but now I know it helps me stay healthy." From that day on, Amy made a dentist appointment every six months and never had a serious toothache again.

grammar: so + 形容詞/副詞 + that + 結果子句：表示「如此...以致於...」，強調原因造成的結果。例如：It was so painful that she could not eat her favorite ice cream.；Amy felt so relieved that she wanted to celebrate.
have to / must 表示義務「必須」：have to 常用於客觀、一般性的必要；must 常用於說話者主觀強調或重要規定。例如：You have to see a dentist right away.；You must brush your teeth twice a day.
used to + 原形動詞：表示「過去經常/曾經」的習慣或狀態，暗示現在已不再如此。例如：Amy used to be afraid of the dentist's office when she was younger.；I used to hate going to the dentist.

reading.q: Why couldn't Amy eat her favorite ice cream last week?
opts: She didn't like ice cream anymore
reading.ex: 文中提到 It was so painful that she could not eat her favorite ice cream，因為牙痛太痛了。

reading.q: How did Amy feel about dentists when she was younger?
opts: She loved going to the dentist
She used to be afraid of the dentist's office
She wanted to become a dentist
reading.ex: 文中提到 Amy used to be afraid of the dentist's office when she was younger。

reading.q: What did the dentist do first during the checkup?
reading.ex: 文中提到 First, the dentist took an X-ray to look inside Amy's tooth。

reading.q: What did the dentist tell Amy to do every night?
reading.ex: 文中提到 the dentist 要求 Amy 每晚 floss every night，用牙線清潔牙齒。

reading.q: How did Amy feel on the way home?
opts: So relieved that she wanted to celebrate
reading.ex: 文中提到 Amy felt so relieved that she wanted to celebrate。

grammar.q: It was ___ painful that she could not eat her ice cream.
grammar.ex: so + 形容詞 + that 子句表示「如此...以致於...」，故選 so。

grammar.q: You ___ see a dentist right away.
grammar.ex: 表示「必須」的義務，用 have to，故選 have to。

grammar.q: Amy ___ be afraid of the dentist's office when she was younger.
grammar.ex: used to + 原形動詞表示「過去經常/曾經」的習慣，故選 used to。

grammar.q: You ___ brush your teeth twice a day.
grammar.ex: must 表示強調的義務或規定，故選 must。

grammar.q: Amy felt so relieved ___ she wanted to celebrate.
grammar.ex: so...that... 為固定搭配，表示結果，故選 that。

vocab.q: "toothache" 這個字的中文意思最接近？
vocab.ex: toothache 指「牙痛」，文中指 Amy 上週牙痛。

vocab.q: 選出與 "nervous" 意思最接近的選項：
vocab.ex: nervous 指「緊張的」，意思最接近 anxious。

vocab.q: "The checkup was ___, so Amy didn't feel any pain." 依句意選出最適合的字：
vocab.ex: 句意指健康檢查「不痛」，應選 painless。
relieved 指「鬆一口氣的」，文中形容 Amy 看完牙醫後放心的感覺。
